description:
Cast Quina by paying its mana cost.
When Quina enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Quina with haste plus at least one additional token due to Quina's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of Citanul Hierophants to tap one of the Quina tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Quina.
Holding priority, use the ability of Citanul Hierophants to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.
